== Notes ==
* It is best used as a sustained, passive [[self-healing skill]], e.g. for navigating areas with [[health degeneration]] or numerous [[interrupt]]s.
* It is a prominent optional component of [[55 monk]] builds.
* It [[heal]]s very slowly compared to other healing spells; however, it has relatively high healing when compared to other healing spells. For every 5 [[energy]] lost by the -1 energy degeneration, it heals for 90 [[health]] at rank 8 and 120 at rank 13.

== Trivia ==
* This skill's poor reputation is partially because of its use in the standard [[Wammo]] build, which is considered to be a very weak choice.
